provenance.note: Census Geocoder Exact match: 217 PERSHING AVE, SAN ANTONIO, TX, 78209

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based: One of the four employee records reviewed did not have the in person pediatric CPR training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based (26 TAC §746.1315(b)(1))

occurrences.finding: Posting of Activity Plan: Written activity plan was not posted in two of the classrooms.    Note: This was corrected during inspection when written activity plans were posted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting of Activity Plan (26 TAC §746.2209)

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training- Required Content: One out of the four staff files reviewed, did not have the required content health and safety trainings for the last full year of employment.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training- Required Content (26 TAC §746.1309(e))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records -Training Hours: Recited from the original deficiency: Five out of five staff files reviewed were missing the required training hours for the allocated year.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records -Training Hours (26 TAC §746.901(6))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Hazards Removed or Repaired: One of the swings on the playground is broken and in need of repairs.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Hazards Removed or Repaired (26 TAC §746.4751(c))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Health Statement: Eight out of ten children's files reviewed were missing health statement from physisians.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records -Training Hours: Five out of five staff files reviewed  were missing the required training hours for the allocated year.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records -Training Hours (26 TAC §746.901(6))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact: Ten out of ten children files reviewed were missing emergancy contact addresses.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §746.605(6))

occurrences.finding: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes: When reviewing the monthly fire drills, it was noted that the April drill was not conducted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §746.5205(1))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric First Aid with Rescue Breathing: Five of eight staff files reviewed did not include current training hours in pediatric first aid.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric First Aid with Rescue Breathing (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(3)(A))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR: Five of eight employee records reviewed did not have pediatric CPR training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR (26 TAC §746.1315(b))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit: Two of eight employee records reviewed did not have an affidavit on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985) (26 TAC §746.901(4))

occurrences.finding: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes: There was no documentation of fire drills being conducted since 10/8/23.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §746.5205(1))

occurrences.finding: Report Number of Employees: The operation did not report the number of employees who ceased employment in 2023 by the required date.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Number of Employees (26 TAC §746.303(b))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric First Aid with Rescue Breathing: Three of the five staff files reviewed did not include current training hours in pediatric first aid.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric First Aid with Rescue Breathing (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(3)(A))

occurrences.finding: Medication No Longer Used: An epi-pen with an expiration date of 12/2022 was still in the medication cabinet.   Noted: this was corrected during the inspection when the epi pen was removed to give back to the parent.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Medication No Longer Used (26 TAC §746.3809)

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training- Required Content: 6 out of the 8 staff records reviewed were missing annual training in the required following topics: (1) Emergency preparedness, (2) Preventing and controlling the spread of communicable diseases, including immunizations, (3) Administering medication, if applicable,(4) Preventing and responding to emergencies due to food or an allergic reaction, (5) Understanding building and physical premises safety, including identification and protection from hazards that can cause bodily injury such as electrical hazards, bodies of water, and vehicular traffic & (6) Handling, storing, and disposing of hazardous materials
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training- Required Content (26 TAC §746.1309(e))

occurrences.finding: Annual Sanitation Inspection: The operation did not have a sanitation inspection on file that had been conducted within the  last 12 months.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Sanitation Inspection (26 TAC §746.3401(a))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered: There were multiple outlets observed that did not have outlet covers.     Note: This was corrected at inspection when the director put outlet covers in all of the outlets.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered (26 TAC §746.3701(1))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required: There were 4 out of the 5 staff files that did not have the required 24 hours of annual training available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required (26 TAC §746.1309(a))

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Proper Depth Maintained: There were 2 inches of loose fill where the swings were located. There was less then 1 inch of loose fill where the pull up bars were located.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Proper Depth Maintained (26 TAC §746.4907(d))

occurrences.finding: Fire Extinguishers Serviced: The fire extinguishers were last serviced in November 2020.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Extinguishers Serviced (26 TAC §746.5307(b))

occurrences.finding: Director Annual Training 30 Hours Required: The director did not have 30 hours of required annual training available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Annual Training 30 Hours Required (26 TAC §746.1311(a))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: There was a caregiver in a classroom that did not have an initial background check submitted.     Note: The caregiver immediately came out of the classroom, and was no longer in the presence of children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Documentation of Drills: There were no documentation of emergency drills available for review for the year 2022.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documentation of Drills (26 TAC §746.5205(4))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - No Entanglement Protrusions or Openings: Underneath the playground structure there were screws that were protruding out of the wood planks. The screw points were the ends that were protruding out of the wood planks.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - No Entanglement Protrusions or Openings (26 TAC §746.4601(4))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking.: Upon review of five employee files there were no updated CPR and First Aid cards available in their files.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking. (26 TAC §746.1315(a))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required: There were 4 out of the 5 staff files that did not have the required 24 hours of annual training available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required (26 TAC §746.1309(a))

occurrences.finding: Fire Extinguishers Serviced: The fire extinguishers were last serviced in November 2020.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Extinguishers Serviced (26 TAC §746.5307(b))

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Proper Depth Maintained: There were 2 inches of loose fill where the swings were located. There was less then 1 inch of loose fill where the pull up bars were located.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Proper Depth Maintained (26 TAC §746.4907(d))

occurrences.finding: Director Annual Training 30 Hours Required: The director did not have 30 hours of required annual training available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Annual Training 30 Hours Required (26 TAC §746.1311(a))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: Air condition cord in the three year old classroom was laying on the floor below the air conditionner  in access of children .
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean: Carpets in the preschool room had not been routinely  cleaned resulting in the rug having multiple stains.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean (26 TAC §746.3407(9))
